annotations.title: Shop the look from a design

description: Find real products that match an item in a room photo or a House AI design, for example the sofa, rug or pendant light in a redesign. Pass the design's image_url and the item to find.

country.description: Two-letter country code for local stores, for example 'US'.
country.title: Country

item.description: The item to match, for example 'sofa', 'rug', 'pendant light'.
item.title: Item

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

name: shop_this_look
title: Shop the look from a design
